_about: Calculator slugs accepted from RECS (RECS docs/spec.md §10.8, FR-10.8.2). Authoritative copy; frontend/config/recs.json must be identical (drift test). To add a calculator: add the slug here and in frontend/config/recs.json, add EN/FR labels (recs.calculator.<slug>), deploy, then tell RECS to turn Send on for it (.specify/specs/003-recs-import/quickstart.md §5).
